Press conference

Introductory statement

Inflation stood at 2.4% in June 2026 and is projected to average 2.2% in 2027.

The unemployment rate stood at 6.3%.

Wage growth is expected to average 3.0% in 2027.

Inflation remains close to the 2% target.

Questions and answers

Question: How fast is the economy growing?

Answer: GDP is projected to grow by 1.4% in 2027 and by 1.6% in 2028.

European Central Bank, 2026
